classification_simplification.tradeoff: Removes the retained membership index, refinement callbacks and mutation guards. Authoritative maps retain their old snapshot masks through Tracked. Read-only access stays clean; key-only GC retention marks only removals, including on unwind. Ordinary mutable HashMap access conservatively dirties its sections, including unsuccessful remove. No claim of a speedup: every measured ratio is a slowdown, within the existing 1.25 ceiling.

validation.clippy: Strict VM all-targets and snapshot library pass. An optional broader snapshot all-targets run reports the pre-existing manual_is_multiple_of warning at tests/gc_machine.rs:298 under rustc 1.91.1.
validation.oracle: Unavailable locally; VM tests are oracle-free. Oracle diagnostic expectations were updated explicitly, without a generic skip, and require the oracle CI lane.

carried_costs: Shared catch maps copy on mutation; saving a frame with mem::take allocates an empty Rc.

ErrorInfo construction metadata remains serialized for compatibility and stack frames; live properties determine display text. New engine error messages allocate unmetered metadata and an own message property through the existing internal_error path.
Snapshot dirty tracking and authoritative side-table GC/restore work remain after removing classification machinery.
diagnostic_policy: Host diagnostics never execute guest coercion. Live error data fields are read through ordinary prototypes; accessors, proxies and object-valued fields have explicit placeholders. Guest String(error) remains observable.
